{{Event infobox | level = 80 | location = Leyspring Hollows | type = Meta event | requires = voe }} [[Depths of Cruelty]] is a level 80 [[meta event]] that occurs in [[Leyspring Hollows]]; taking place at [[Doyen's Adytum]], [[The Auguratorium]], and [[Ley Distributary]], concluding on [[Navarium Core]].
__TOC__
== Event schedule == {{Event timer|voe-lh|style=margin-right:280px;}} This event occurs every three hours, with a countdown starting 5 minutes prior. Start times: {{UTC time|02:00}}, {{UTC time|05:00}}, {{UTC time|08:00}}, {{UTC time|11:00}}, {{UTC time|14:00}}, {{UTC time|17:00}}, {{UTC time|20:00}}, {{UTC time|23:00}} == Objectives == * ''The twisting hollows of the depths are calm.'' * ''You and your allies are receiving distress signals. Adytum]], [[The Auguratorium]], and [[Ley Distributary]]). # Each group will have to capture and control 3 zones at their location - either at the same time or sequentially, it doesn't matter. # One champion will spawn after taking the capture points. === Stage 2 === # Each group would have to defend their rift, while portal opens up to the boss ([[Mark III Suppressor Golem]]). # Boss will kick the players in the arena out at 75% and 50%, rotate a new group of players in (previously kicked out can still join the arena). # At 25% HP all 3 rifts would be stabilized, and all groups can join in fighting the boss. === Stage 3 === # Split into 2 groups each going to one of the middle platforms. # Western ([[Project 5388]]) would have to deal with mutations and break free the prisoners in the vats. # Eastern ([[Subject Gamma]]) would have to deal with a lot of dots, CC bar every 25% HP, and ball catching mechanic (similar to the fractal ball). # After the mini bosses are dead, after a short delay the players will have to break free prisoners on each platform. === Stage 4 === {{main|Defeat Kuda and her twisted creation#Walkthrough}} # Fight the [[Twisted Creation]] on the higher platform, avoid stacking on it, it does a heavy [[AoE]] attack (sword skill). #* Boss's sword skill occurs after the brand meteor (the purple skill) or dash, if you see it perform one of these two, be ready to dodge. # At 75%, 50%, and 25% ball catching (2, 3, and 4 balls in order). # At 66%, 33%, and 10% the boss will become immune while the leylines appear around the platform. #* Half the players should stay on the boss's platform and break the vats, freeing players, and killing any Champion Mutations released. If this isn't being done reliably, more players should stay back and complete this step before heading aloft to break the shield. #* The other half should go up the leylines to the floating debris and destroy the shield. #* Once the shield is destroyed the boss becomes attackable again. == NPCs == === Allies === {{section-stub|event}} === Foes === {{section-stub|event}} == Dialogue == {{section-stub|event|Missing dialogue}} === Stage 1 === ;Before events begin :'''R'tchikk:''' ''Is anyone there?
